project_context.name: AcadéPost
project_context.stack: Next.js, NestJS, Prisma, Docker Compose, Temporal, Redis, PostgreSQL, nginx, PM2

raw_ideas: Use GHCR prebuilt demo images instead of server-side builds.
Fold server-found Docker fixes back into source control.
Replace visible old logo surfaces with the AcadéPost brand asset.

backlog.problem: Server deploys were building from source instead of pulling a reusable image.
backlog.mvp: GitHub Actions publishes ghcr.io/foogoolin/acadepost:demo and launchers pull it.

backlog.problem: Temporal, Elasticsearch and PM2 paths required manual server overrides.
The visible app shell still showed the old placeholder logo.
backlog.mvp: Shared logo/favicons/static logos use the AcadéPost brand asset.

review_findings: Temporal needs BIND_ON_IP=0.0.0.0 in multi-network compose setups.
Elasticsearch bind-mount directory must be writable by uid/gid 1000.
PM2 scripts must point to apps/*/dist/apps/*/src/main.js.
The sidebar Logo component still rendered the old p-mark.

blocking_issues: Local Docker Engine pipe is unavailable on Windows, so docker build --check could not run locally.

doc_log: PROJECT_PLAN.md updated with deployment and logo cleanup notes.
notes: User explicitly asked to continue, so FD gates were handled as an execution pass instead of pausing for menu confirmation.
